content.comment_body: Hello, Can the [product_name] [version_no] module process fast input signals at 50 pulses per second? I intend to use it to totalize flow meter readings. Best regards, [user_name]
Hi, The [product_name] without AC power supply has fast counter capability; the manual states it supports up to 5 kHz. Standard digital inputs are limited to 4 Hz. Thank you, [user_name]
Yes, the [version_no] variant provides four fast input channels (I3-I6).

analysis.insight_summary: Participants assessed whether the [product_name] [version_no] module could accurately register rapid pulses from a flow meter at 50 per second. There was uncertainty about input performance, which was resolved by discussing the distinction between common digital and specialized fast inputs, highlighting significant differences in their abilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] [version_no] module to accurately count 50 pulses per second generated by a flow meter.
